Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was rear-ended.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a busy surface street in Houston, Texas, near a shopping center. Traffic had slowed down, and I had
stopped behind a car at a red light.
Q: What happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back, and my car was pushed into the vehicle in
front of me. The other driver said they looked down at their phone and didn't see that the light had turned red.
Q: Were you taken to a hospital or doctor after the accident?
A: Not right away. A paramedic checked me at the scene. My right knee hit the dashboard, and it became swollen
and painful within a couple of hours. I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening, and they told me to see an
orthopedic doctor.
Q: Have you had any prior injuries to that knee?
A: No, not that I can recall. I played recreational soccer years ago, but I never had surgery or ongoing problems.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes. I'm doing physical therapy twice a week, and the doctor mentioned an MRI to check for ligament damage. I've
been unable to work full shifts since the collision.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm still cooperating and want to resolve this fairly. I can send you my medical records once I receive
them.
</page>
